parameters.name: start_date
parameters.value: ={{ (() => { const s = $json.body ? $json.body.startDate : $json.startDate; const max = new Date(Date.now() + 14 * 86400000).toISOString().split('T')[0]; return (!s || s > max) ? max : s; })() }}

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.value: ={{ (() => { const e = $json.body ? $json.body.endDate : $json.endDate; const max = new Date(Date.now() + 14 * 86400000).toISOString().split('T')[0]; return (!e || e > max) ? max : e; })() }}
